EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows (a) strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2880–2970 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), (b) a very high-frequency carbonyl band at 1817 cm⁻¹ consistent with highly electron-withdrawing acyl derivatives (not amides/ketones), and (c) a strong band at 966 cm⁻¹ characteristic of an O–F stretch in hypofluorites. CCC(=O)OF (an acyl hypofluorite) uniquely fits these features among the candidates: it explains the ~1820 cm⁻¹ C=O and the ~960 cm⁻¹ O–F band, as well as C–O-related bands near 829 and 713 cm⁻¹. Other candidates are amides/ketones (expected C=O ~1650–1750 cm⁻¹) or lack a carbonyl entirely, and cannot account for the 1817 cm⁻¹ peak.
